visual_elements.description: Confusion matrix diagram. Left side labeled 'Positive' in red. Right side labeled 'Negative' in green. Left: airplane icon above red circle '30'. Arrows from '30' to red circle '20' (labeled TP below) and green circle '10' (labeled FN below). Right: airplane icon above green circle '70'. Arrows from '70' to green circle '59' (labeled TN below) and red circle '11' (labeled FP below).
Two rounded rectangles. Top yellow box: 'Precision =' with fraction TP/(TP+FP). Bottom blue box: 'Recall =' with fraction TP/(TP+FN).
Green rounded rectangle with text: 'Good Model: Properly Classifies 20 out of 30 as Positive Properly Classifies 59 out of 70 as Negative'.
Three horizontal boxes. First yellow: 'Precision= 20/(20+11) =64.5%'. Second blue: 'Recall= 20/(20+10) =66.6%'. Third white with blue border: 'Average= 68.7%+60% =65.55%'.

imagery: Two simple line drawings of airplanes, one on left (Positive) and one on right (Negative). Style: outline, black. Position: above circles 30 and 70.
typography_notes: Sans-serif font (likely Arial or Calibri). Title bold, large, red. Body text black, regular. Labels Positive/Negative bold, colored red/green. Numbers in circles white bold. Formulas in boxes black. Slide number black in yellow circle.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title 'Combine Precision and Recall in one number' at top left, red, bold, large. 3. Add yellow circle with '13' at top right. 4. Draw a red-bordered rectangle for the diagram area on the left. 5. Inside, add 'Positive' (red) and 'Negative' (green) labels at top. 6. Place two airplane icons above the circles. 7. Draw red circle '30' and green circle '70'. 8. Draw blue arrows from '30' to red circle '20' and green circle '10'; from '70' to green circle '59' and red circle '11'. 9. Add labels TP, FN, TN, FP below respective circles. 10. On the right, add two rounded rectangles: yellow with 'Precision = TP/(TP+FP)' and blue with 'Recall = TP/(TP+FN)'. 11. Below diagram, add green rounded rectangle with 'Good Model:' and the two classification lines. 12. Below that, add three horizontal boxes: yellow 'Precision= 20/(20+11) =64.5%', blue 'Recall= 20/(20+10) =66.6%', white with blue border 'Average= 68.7%+60% =65.55%'. 13. Use black text for all body text, red for title and Positive, green for Negative and TN, blue for arrows and borders.
